rising_resentment.type_zh: 龙裔 忍者 行动·攻击
rising_resentment.text_zh:
当攀升的怨恨命中时，你可以放逐你手牌中一张费用小于你控制的龙裔链环数量的攻击行动牌。若如此做，它的使用费用减少1点资源，且本回合你可以使用它。
再动
rising_resentment.text_en:
When Rising Resentment hits, you may banish an attack action card from your hand with cost less than the number of Draconic chain links you control. If you do, it costs {r} less to play and you may play it this turn.
Go again

rising_solartide.text_zh: 若升起的日潮命中，将其置入你的英雄的灵魂。
rising_solartide.text_en: If Rising Solartide hits, put it into your hero's soul.

rising_speed.type_zh: 蛮将·战士 行动·攻击
rising_speed.text_zh: 若本回合你抽过牌，此牌获得再动。
rising_speed.text_en: If you've drawn a card this turn, this gets go again.

rising_sun_setting_moon.name_zh: 升起的太阳，落下的月亮
rising_sun_setting_moon.text_zh:
传奇
抽一张牌，然后将你手牌中的一张牌置于你的牌库底。
若本回合你使用过另一张蓝色牌，超越。
rising_sun_setting_moon.text_en:
Legendary
Draw a card, then put a card from your hand on the bottom of your deck.
If you've played another blue card this turn, transcend.

rising_tide.text_zh: 若本回合你使用过另一张蓝色牌，此牌获得+2力量。
rising_tide.text_en: If you've played another blue card this turn, this gets +2{p}.

rites_of_earthlore.text_zh:
当此牌进入竞技场时，创造一个地震涌动衍生物。
在你的回合开始时，摧毁此牌，然后你本回合使用的下一张守护者攻击行动牌获得+3力量。
rites_of_earthlore.text_en:
When this enters the arena, create a Seismic Surge token.
At the start of your turn, destroy this, then the next Guardian attack action card you play this turn gets +3{p}.

rites_of_lightning.type_zh: 元素 符文剑士 行动·攻击
rites_of_lightning.text_zh:
闪电融合
当你用闪电仪式攻击时，若它已融合，对目标英雄造成1点秘法伤害。
若本回合你造成过秘法伤害，闪电仪式获得再动。
rites_of_lightning.text_en:
Lightning Fusion
When you attack with Rites of Lightning, if it was fused, deal 1 arcane damage to target hero.
If you have dealt arcane damage this turn, Rites of Lightning gains go again.

rites_of_replenishment.type_zh: 元素 符文剑士 行动·攻击
rites_of_replenishment.text_zh:
大地融合
当你用补足仪式攻击时，若本回合你造成过秘法伤害，你可以将你坟场中的一张“非攻击”行动牌置于你的牌库底。
当你用补足仪式攻击时，若它已融合，你可以将你坟场中的一张攻击行动牌置于你的牌库底。
rites_of_replenishment.text_en:
Earth Fusion
When you attack with Rites of Replenishment, if you have dealt arcane damage this turn, you may put a 'non-attack' action card from your graveyard on the bottom of your deck.
When you attack with Rites of Replenishment, if it was fused, you may put an attack action card from your graveyard on the bottom of your deck.

roar_of_the_tiger.text_zh:
在你的手牌中创造一张卧虎。
本回合你控制的卧虎获得+1力量。
再动
roar_of_the_tiger.text_en:
Create a Crouching Tiger in your hand.
Crouching Tigers you control gain +1{p} this turn.
Go again

roaring_beam.type_zh: 光 战士 攻击反应
roaring_beam.text_zh:
创造一个勇气衍生物。
若你的灵魂中没有牌，将此牌移回其拥有者的手牌，然后为你的灵魂充能。
roaring_beam.text_en:
Create a Courage token.
If there are no cards in your soul, return this to its owner's hand, then charge your soul.

rob_the_rich.text_zh:
契约——你受契约束缚以放逐对手的费用为2或更高的牌。每当你完成此契约时，创造一个银币衍生物。
当此牌命中英雄时，放逐其牌库顶的一张牌。
rob_the_rich.text_en:
Contract - You are contracted to banish opponents' cards with cost 2 or greater. Whenever you complete this contract, create a Silver token.
When this hits a hero, banish the top card of their deck.

robe_of_astral_sanctuary.text_zh: 瞬间——横置你的英雄，摧毁此牌：防止本回合接下来将对你造成的1点伤害。
robe_of_astral_sanctuary.text_en: Instant - {t} your hero, destroy this: Prevent the next 1 damage that would be dealt to you this turn.

robe_of_autumns_fall.text_zh:
当你控制的秋之刃命中时，你可以摧毁此牌。若如此做，获得1点资源。
秘法屏障1
robe_of_autumns_fall.text_en:
When an Edge of Autumn you control hits, you may destroy this. If you do, gain {r}.
Arcane Barrier 1

robe_of_rapture.text_zh:
行动——摧毁狂喜长袍：获得3点资源。
秘法屏障1
robe_of_rapture.text_en:
Action - Destroy Robe of Rapture: Gain {r}{r}{r}.
Arcane Barrier 1

robe_of_resourcefulness.text_zh:
当此牌离开竞技场时，获得2点资源。
刃碎
robe_of_resourcefulness.text_en:
When this leaves the arena, gain {r}{r}.
Blade Break

rockslide_trap.type_zh: 游侠 防御反应·陷阱
rockslide_trap.text_zh:
仅能从军械库使用落石陷阱。
当此牌防御时，目标攻击获得-2力量，除非攻击英雄支付1点资源。
rockslide_trap.text_en:
Rockslide Trap can only be played from arsenal.
When this defends, target attack gets -2{p}, unless the attacking hero pays {r}.

rockyard_rodeo.text_zh: 此牌的力量等于你控制的武器的最高基础力量。
rockyard_rodeo.text_en: This card's {p} is equal to the highest base {p} of weapons you control.

roiling_fissure.text_zh:
摧毁一张费用为X或更低的光环，然后你可以摧毁你控制的一个地震涌动。若如此做，重复此过程。
再动
roiling_fissure.text_en:
Destroy an aura with cost X or less, then you may destroy a Seismic Surge you control. If you do, repeat this process.
Go again

rok.text_zh:
每回合一次行动——支付3点资源：攻击
仅当你手牌中没有牌时才能启动岩块。
岩块将造成的伤害不能被防止。
rok.text_en:
Once per Turn Action - {r}{r}{r}: Attack
Activate Rok only if you have no cards in hand.
Damage that would be dealt by Rok can't be prevented.

rolling_thunder.text_zh:
掷一枚六面骰。你本回合的下一次蛮将攻击获得+X力量，X为掷出的数字。
再动
rolling_thunder.text_en:
Roll a 6 sided die. Your next Brute attack this turn gains +X{p}, where X the number rolled.
Go again

romping_club.text_zh:
每回合一次行动——支付2点资源：攻击
每回合一次效果——当你弃置一张力量为6或更高的牌时，欢闹之棒直到回合结束获得+1力量。
romping_club.text_en:
Once per Turn Action - {r}{r}: Attack
Once per Turn Effect - When you discard a card with 6 or more {p}, Romping Club gains +1{p} until end of turn.

ronin_renegade.type_zh: 龙裔 忍者 行动·攻击

root_bound_trunks.type_zh: 大地 守护者 装备·腿部
root_bound_trunks.text_zh:
当此牌与一张光环牌一起防御时，创造一个大地化身衍生物。
刃碎
root_bound_trunks.text_en:
When this defends together with an aura card, create an Embodiment of Earth token.
Blade Break

rootbound_carapace.text_zh: 分解——你可以放逐坟场中的两张大地牌和一张行动牌。若如此做，此牌获得+1防御。
rootbound_carapace.text_en: Decompose - You may banish 2 Earth cards and an action card from your graveyard. If you do, this gets +1{d}.

rosetta_thorn.type_zh: 符文剑士 武器·剑 （双手）
rosetta_thorn.text_zh:
每回合一次行动——支付1点资源：攻击
每当你用罗塞塔之棘攻击时，若本回合你使用过一张攻击行动牌和一张“非攻击”行动牌，对目标英雄造成2点秘法伤害。
rosetta_thorn.text_en:
Once per Turn Action - {r}: Attack
Whenever you attack with Rosetta Thorn, if you've played an attack action card and a 'non-attack' action card this turn, deal 2 arcane damage to target hero.

rotary_ram.text_zh:
你本回合使用的下一张机械师攻击行动牌获得+3力量。
若本回合你推进过，将旋转冲压置于你的牌库底。
再动
rotary_ram.text_en:
The next Mechanologist attack action card you play this turn gains +3{p}.
If you have boosted this turn, put Rotary Ram on the bottom of your deck.
Go again

rotten_remains.text_zh: 当此牌攻击时，你可以放逐每位英雄坟场中一张力量为1的牌。若如此做，此牌获得+1力量，然后重复此过程。
rotten_remains.text_en: When this attacks, you may banish a card with 1{p} from each hero's graveyard. If you do, this gets +1{p}, then repeat this process.

rotwood_reaper.type_zh: 大地 符文剑士 武器·剑 （双手）
rotwood_reaper.text_zh:
每回合一次行动——支付2点资源：攻击
若本回合你使用过或创造过一个光环，此牌获得+2力量。
rotwood_reaper.text_en:
Once per Turn Action - {r}{r}: Attack
If you've played or created an aura this turn, this gets +2{p}.

rough_up.text_zh: 当此牌攻击时，若你资源区中有一张力量为6或更高的牌，此牌获得+1力量。
rough_up.text_en: When this attacks, if there is a card with 6 or more {p} in your pitch zone, this gets +1{p}.

rouse_the_ancients.text_zh: 作为使用唤醒古代者的额外费用，你可以展示你手牌中力量总和为13或更多的任意数量的攻击行动牌。若如此做，唤醒古代者获得+7力量和再动。
rouse_the_ancients.text_en: As an additional cost to play Rouse the Ancients, you may reveal any number of attack action cards from your hand with 13 or more total {p}. If you do, Rouse the Ancients gains +7{p} and go again.

rousing_aether.text_zh:
对目标英雄造成4点秘法伤害。
本回合你使用的下一张具有造成秘法伤害效果的牌改为造成等量加1的秘法伤害。
rousing_aether.text_en:
Deal 4 arcane damage to target hero.
The next card you play this turn with an effect that deals arcane damage, instead deals that much arcane damage plus 1.

rout.text_zh:
目标武器攻击获得+3力量。
重演——若防御英雄在此链环中用手牌中的牌防御过，你可以将目标非装备防御牌移回其拥有者的手牌。
rout.text_en:
Target weapon attack gains +3{p}.
Reprise - If the defending hero has defended with a card from their hand this chain link, you may return target non-equipment defending card to its owners hand.

rowdy_locals.text_zh:
若此牌被行动牌防御，此牌获得+2力量。
当此牌命中英雄时，弃一张牌。若如此做，该英雄弃一张牌。
rowdy_locals.text_en:
If this is defended by an action card, this gets +2{p}.
When this hits a hero, discard a card. If you do, they discard a card.

ruby_amulet.text_zh:
瞬间——摧毁此牌：获得2点资源。
水葬传说
ruby_amulet.text_en:
Instant - Destroy this: Gain {r}{r}
Legend of the Watery Grave

rugged_roller.text_zh:
每回合一次行动——支付1点资源：攻击
仅当本回合你掷骰掷出过6时才能启动粗犷滚筒。
rugged_roller.text_en:
Once per Turn Action - {r}: Attack
Activate Rugged Roller only if you've rolled a 6 on a die this turn.

rumble_grunting.text_zh:
仅当本回合你弃置过一张力量为6或更高的牌时才能使用轰隆闷哼。
你本回合的下一次蛮将攻击获得+4力量。
再动
rumble_grunting.text_en:
Play Rumble Grunting only if you've discarded a card with 6 or more {p} this turn.
Your next Brute attack this turn gains +4{p}.
Go again

run_into_trouble.text_zh: 当此牌防御时，若你控制一个敏捷衍生物，对攻击英雄造成伤害。
run_into_trouble.text_en: When this defends, if you control an Agility token, deal damage to the attacking hero.

run_roughshod.text_zh: 仅当本回合你弃置过一张力量为6或更高的牌时才能使用此牌。
run_roughshod.text_en: Play this only if you've discarded a card with 6 or more {p} this turn.

run_through.text_zh:
目标剑攻击获得再动。
你本回合的下一次剑攻击获得+3力量。
run_through.text_en:
Target sword attack gets go again.
Your next sword attack this turn gets +3{p}.

runaways.text_zh: 瞬间——摧毁逃跑者：防止本回合接下来将对你的英雄造成的1点伤害。仅当你的英雄本回合受到过伤害时才能启动此异能。
runaways.text_en: Instant - Destroy Runaways: Prevent the next 1 damage that would be dealt to your hero this turn. Activate this ability only if your hero has been dealt damage this turn.

rune_flash.type_zh: 符文剑士 行动·攻击
rune_flash.text_zh:
每当你控制一个符文吟唱衍生物，此牌的使用费用减少1点资源。
再动
rune_flash.text_en:
This costs {r} less to play for each Runechant token you control.
Go again

rune_snare.text_zh:
你本回合的下一次箭矢攻击获得+3力量。
再动
当此牌防御且攻击英雄本回合使用过或创造过2个或更多光环时，摧毁其控制的一个光环。
rune_snare.text_en:
Your next arrow attack this turn gets +3{p}.
Go again
When this defends and the attacking hero has played or created 2 or more auras this turn, destroy an aura they control.

runebleed_robe.type_zh: 符文剑士 装备·胸部
runebleed_robe.text_zh:
瞬间——摧毁此牌和你控制的一个符文吟唱：防止本回合接下来将对你造成的1点秘法伤害。
秘法屏障1
runebleed_robe.text_en:
Instant - Destroy this and a Runechant you control: Prevent the next 1 arcane damage that would be dealt to you this turn.
Arcane Barrier 1

runeblood_barrier.type_zh: 符文剑士 行动·光环
runeblood_barrier.text_zh:
当此牌进入竞技场时，创造4个符文吟唱衍生物。
若你的英雄将受到伤害，改为摧毁你控制的等量符文吟唱衍生物，并每有一个以此方式摧毁的符文吟唱衍生物防止1点伤害。
在你的行动阶段开始时，摧毁此牌。
runeblood_barrier.text_en:
When this enters the arena, create 4 Runechant tokens.
If your hero would be dealt damage, instead destroy that many Runechant tokens you control and prevent 1 damage for each Runechant token destroyed this way.
At the beginning of your action phase, destroy this.

runeblood_incantation.type_zh: 符文剑士 行动·光环
runeblood_incantation.text_zh:
再动
符文血咒文进入竞技场时带有3个诗节指示物。
在你的行动阶段开始时，从符文血咒文上移除一个诗节指示物。若如此做，创造一个符文吟唱衍生物。否则，摧毁符文血咒文。
runeblood_incantation.text_en:
Go again
Runeblood Incantation enters the arena with 3 verse counters on it.
At the beginning of your action phase, remove a verse counter from Runeblood Incantation. If you do create a Runechant token. Otherwise, destroy Runeblood Incantation.

runechant.type_zh: 符文剑士 衍生物·光环
runechant.text_zh: 当你使用攻击行动牌或启动武器攻击时，摧毁此牌并对目标对手英雄造成1点秘法伤害。
runechant.text_en: When you play an attack action card or activate a weapon attack, destroy this and deal 1 arcane damage to target opposing hero.

runechant_of_envy.type_zh: 符文剑士 瞬间·光环
runechant_of_envy.text_zh:
此牌计为一个符文吟唱。当攻击夺取此牌时，获得1点生命。
当此牌被摧毁时，创造一个符文吟唱衍生物。
在你的行动阶段开始时或当你使用攻击行动牌时，摧毁此牌。
runechant_of_envy.text_en:
This counts as a Runechant. When an attack usurps this, gain 1{h}.
When this is destroyed, create a Runechant token.
At the beginning of your action phase or when you play an attack action card, destroy this.

runechant_of_gluttony.type_zh: 符文剑士 瞬间·光环
runechant_of_gluttony.text_zh:
此牌计为一个符文吟唱。当攻击夺取此牌时，获得1点资源。
当此牌被摧毁时，创造一个符文吟唱衍生物。
在你的行动阶段开始时或当你使用攻击行动牌时，摧毁此牌。
runechant_of_gluttony.text_en:
This counts as a Runechant. When an attack usurps this, gain {r}.
When this is destroyed, create a Runechant token.
At the beginning of your action phase or when you play an attack action card, destroy this.

runechant_of_greed.type_zh: 符文剑士 瞬间·光环
runechant_of_greed.text_zh:
此牌计为一个符文吟唱。当攻击夺取此牌时，抽一张牌。
当此牌被摧毁时，创造一个符文吟唱衍生物。
在你的行动阶段开始时或当你使用攻击行动牌时，摧毁此牌。
runechant_of_greed.text_en:
This counts as a Runechant. When an attack usurps this, draw a card.
When this is destroyed, create a Runechant token.
At the beginning of your action phase or when you play an attack action card, destroy this.

runechant_of_lust.type_zh: 符文剑士 瞬间·光环
runechant_of_lust.text_zh:
此牌计为一个符文吟唱。当攻击夺取此牌时，创造一个符文吟唱衍生物。
当此牌被摧毁时，创造一个符文吟唱衍生物。
在你的行动阶段开始时或当你使用攻击行动牌时，摧毁此牌。
runechant_of_lust.text_en:
This counts as a Runechant. When an attack usurps this, create a Runechant token.
When this is destroyed, create a Runechant token.
At the beginning of your action phase or when you play an attack action card, destroy this.

runechant_of_pride.type_zh: 符文剑士 瞬间·光环
runechant_of_pride.text_zh:
此牌计为一个符文吟唱。当攻击夺取此牌时，该攻击获得+1力量。
当此牌被摧毁时，创造一个符文吟唱衍生物。
在你的行动阶段开始时或当你使用攻击行动牌时，摧毁此牌。
runechant_of_pride.text_en:
This counts as a Runechant. When an attack usurps this, it gets +1{p}.
When this is destroyed, create a Runechant token.
At the beginning of your action phase or when you play an attack action card, destroy this.

runechant_of_sloth.type_zh: 符文剑士 瞬间·光环
runechant_of_sloth.text_zh:
此牌计为一个符文吟唱。当攻击夺取此牌时，该攻击获得再动。
当此牌被摧毁时，创造一个符文吟唱衍生物。
在你的行动阶段开始时或当你使用攻击行动牌时，摧毁此牌。
runechant_of_sloth.text_en:
This counts as a Runechant. When an attack usurps this, it gets go again.
When this is destroyed, create a Runechant token.
At the beginning of your action phase or when you play an attack action card, destroy this.

runechant_of_wrath.type_zh: 符文剑士 瞬间·光环
runechant_of_wrath.text_zh:
此牌计为一个符文吟唱。当攻击夺取此牌时，该攻击获得压制。
当此牌被摧毁时，创造一个符文吟唱衍生物。
在你的行动阶段开始时或当你使用攻击行动牌时，摧毁此牌。
runechant_of_wrath.text_en:
This counts as a Runechant. When an attack usurps this, it gets overpower.
When this is destroyed, create a Runechant token.
At the beginning of your action phase or when you play an attack action card, destroy this.

runehold_release.type_zh: 符文剑士 装备·手臂
runehold_release.text_zh: 行动——摧毁此牌：创造一个符文吟唱衍生物。再动
runehold_release.text_en: Action - Destroy this: Create a Runechant token. Go again

runerager_swarm.type_zh: 符文剑士 行动·攻击
runerager_swarm.text_zh: 若本回合你使用过或创造过一个光环，此牌获得再动。
runerager_swarm.text_en: If you've played or created an aura this turn, this gets go again.

rushing_river.text_en: Combo - If Torrent of Tempo was the last attack this combat chain, Rushing River gains +1{p}, go again, and "If Rushing River hits, draw X cards then put X cards from your hand on top of your deck in any order, where X is the number of attacks that have hit this combat chain."
